subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: After resolving the dirty merge, should the resulting exact head land with its generic QA SDK, Gateway admission, and dependency-ownership changes as one stack step?
rationale: The implementation is well-proven, but accepting cross-owner runtime contracts and authorizing the dependency graph are repository-owner decisions that automation cannot safely infer.

options.title: Refresh and land this stack step
options.body: Resolve the merge, inspect and re-prove the exact result, obtain dependency authorization, and land it before the workflow successor.

options.title: Narrow the ownership boundary
options.body: Pause the stack and split generic Gateway or SDK changes into separately owned PRs if reviewers do not accept them as necessary parts of this migration.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land this stack step
recommendation.body: Resolve the merge, inspect and re-prove the exact result, obtain dependency authorization, and land it before the workflow successor.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the recent merged Matrix QA stack history and are best positioned to reconcile the branch and explain why each cross-owner change remains necessary.
